en.quote: Russia never planned any annexations or any military action in Crimea. Never.
en.head: Putin later described an earlier order to “return Crimea.”
en.body: In an interview broadcast in March 2015, Putin said that after a meeting on the night of February 22–23, 2014, he ordered work to begin on “returning Crimea.” That places preparations for the Russian operation before his April claim that annexation or military action had never been planned.

qsrc.t: RBC, report from the Direct Line, April 17, 2014

osrc.t: Interfax, summary of Putin interview on the decision, February 23
